system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 30 spaces

You submerge the target in an illusory dream, rendering them helpless.

Select a creature within 30 spaces and make a 4:1 Soul (Metaphysics) check, resisted by the target's Willpower. If the target is unaware of you, it has Disadvantage on the resistance check.

If the target fails. they are Incapacitated until the start of your next turn, as they are immersed in an illusory dream of your choice.

This effect ends early if the target suffers any kind of damage, pain, or other intense physical reaction. Another creature can use an action to wake the target.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain the effect, so long as the target is still within 30 spaces.
